messages.subject: error in bismark.read()
parts:
Hello,
I am a first time user of methylKit. I am having trouble with a couple things. Below is my code.
library(methylKit)
library(graphics)
##change input files to phytosome output files--need to sort
##read in the associated alignment files into a linked list
file.list <- list(system.file("/lustre/projects/rambani/Jeff/Sequence_Files/Bismark_Output/Allignment/SAM_files",
"Rep1_control_R1_trimmed.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe_sorted.sam", package = "methylKit"), 
system.file( "/lustre/projects/rambani/Jeff/Sequence_Files/Bismark_Output/Allignment/SAM_files",
"Rep1_infected_R1_trimmed.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe_sorted.sam", package = "methylKit"), 
system.file( "/lustre/projects/rambani/Jeff/Sequence_Files/Bismark_Output/Allignment/SAM_files",
"Rep2_control_R1_trimmed.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe_sorted.sam", package = "methylKit"), 
system.file( "/lustre/projects/rambani/Jeff/Sequence_Files/Bismark_Output/Allignment/SAM_files",
"Rep2_infected_R1_trimmed.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe_sorted.sam", package = "methylKit"), 
system.file( "/lustre/projects/rambani/Jeff/Sequence_Files/Bismark_Output/Allignment/SAM_files",
"Rep3_control_R1_trimmed.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe_sorted.sam", package = "methylKit"), 
system.file( "/lustre/projects/rambani/Jeff/Sequence_Files/Bismark_Output/Allignment/SAM_files",
"Rep3_infected_R1_trimmed.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe_sorted.sam", package = "methylKit"))
## this file is of the incorrect type. Needs to be in BED format
##broken
gene.obj <- read.transcript.features(location = system.file("/lustre/projects/rambani/reference_genome",
"Gmax_189_annotation_info.txt", package = "methylkit"))
#CpG context
##incorrect--treatment vector
my.methRaw_CpG <- read.bismark(file.list, sample.id = list("Rep1_control", "Rep2_control", "Rep3_control", "Rep1_infected",
"Rep2_infected", "Rep3_infected"), assembly = "nc1", context = "CpG", treatment = c(1, 1, 0, 0,))

filtered.methRaw_CpG <- filterByCoverave(methRaw_CpG, lo.count = 10, lo.perc = NULL, hi.count = NULL, hi.perc = 99.9)

getMethylationStats(methRaw_CpG[[2]], plot = T, both.strands = F)

getCoverageStats(methRaw_CpG[[2]], plot = T, both.strands = F)

getCorrelation(methRaw_CpG, plot = T)

################################################################################################
tiles <- tileMethylCounts(methRaw_CpG, win.size = 100, step.size = 100)#ADJUST WINDOW SIZE HERE#
################################################################################################
##output methylation stats of tiles object
head(tiles[[1]])
#calculate methylation differential
myDiff <- calculateDiffMeth(tiles)
#break down into hypo and hyper context
myDiff25p.hyper <- getMethylDiff(myDiff, difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01, type = "hyper")

myDiff25p.hypo <- getMethylDiff(myDiff, difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01, type = "hypo")
#calculate percent differential
diffMethPerChr(myDiff, plot = T, qvalue.cutoff = 0.01, meth.cutoff = 25)
#annotates
annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff25p, gene.obj)
#break down the annotated genome into parts
##and print out data associated with them
promoters <- regionCounts(methRaw_CpG, gene.obj$promoters)
head(promoters[[1]])
introns <- regionCounts(methRaw_CpG, gene.obj$introns)
head(introns[[1]])
exons <- regionCounts(methRaw_CpG, gene.obj$exons)
head(exons[[1]])
##anotate your output
diffAnn <- annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff25p, gene.obj)
head(getAssociationWithTSS(diffAnn))
##get other data
getTargetAnnotationStats(diffAnn, percentage = TRUE, precedence = TRUE)

plotTargetAnnotation(diffAnn, precedence = TRUE, main = "Differential Methylation Annotation")

getFeatsWithTargetStats(diffAnn, percentage = TRUE)

##CHH context
my.methRaw_CHH <- read.bismark(file.list, sample.id = list("Rep1_control", "Rep2_control", "Rep3_control", "Rep1_infected",
"Rep2_infected", "Rep3_infected"), assembly = "nc1", context = "CHH", treatment = c(1, 1, 0, 0,))

filtered.methRaw_CHH <- filterByCoverave(methRaw_CHH, lo.count = 10, lo.perc = NULL, hi.count = NULL, hi.perc = 99.9)

getMethylationStats(methRaw_CHH[[2]], plot = T, both.strands = F)

getCoverageStats(methRaw_CHH[[2]], plot = T, both.strands = F)

getCorrelation(methRaw_CHH, plot = T)

###################################################################################################
tiles <- tileMethylCounts(methRaw_CHH, win.size = 100, step.size = 100) ## ADJUST WINDOW SIZE HERE#
###################################################################################################

head(tiles[[1]])

myDiff <- calculateDiffMeth(tiles)

myDiff25p.hyper <- getMethylDiff(myDiff, difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01, type = "hyper")

myDiff25p.hypo <- getMethylDiff(myDiff, difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01, type = "hypo")

diffMethPerChr(myDiff, plot = T, qvalue.cutoff = 0.01, meth.cutoff = 25)

annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff25p, gene.obj)

promoters <- regionCounts(methRaw_CHH, gene.obj$promoters)
head(promoters[[1]])
introns <- regionCounts(methRaw_CHH, gene.obj$introns)
head(introns[[1]])
exons <- regionCounts(methRaw_CHH, gene.obj$exons)
head(exons[[1]])

diffAnn <- annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff25p, gene.obj)
head(getAssociationWithTSS(diffAnn))

getTargetAnnotationStats(diffAnn, percentage = TRUE, precedence = TRUE)

plotTargetAnnotation(diffAnn, precedence = TRUE, main = "Differential Methylation Annotation")

getFeatsWithTargetStats(diffAnn, percentage = TRUE)

##CHG context
my.methRaw_CpG <- read.bismark(file.list, sample.id = list("Rep1_control", "Rep2_control", "Rep3_control", "Rep1_infected",
"Rep2_infected", "Rep3_infected"), assembly = "nc1", context = "CHG", treatment = c(1, 1, 0, 0,))

filtered.methRaw_CHG <- filterByCoverave(methRaw_CHG, lo.count = 10, lo.perc = NULL, hi.count = NULL, hi.perc = 99.9)

getMethylationStats(methRaw_CHG[[2]], plot = T, both.strands = F)

getCoverageStats(methRaw_CHG[[2]], plot = T, both.strands = F)

getCorrelation(methRaw_CHG, plot = T)

################################################################################################
tiles <- tileMethylCounts(methRaw_CHG, win.size = 100, step.size = 100)#ADJUST WINDOW SIZE HERE#
################################################################################################

head(tiles[[1]])

myDiff <- calculateDiffMeth(tiles)

myDiff25p.hyper <- getMethylDiff(myDiff, difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01, type = "hyper")

myDiff25p.hypo <- getMethylDiff(myDiff, difference = 25, qvalue = 0.01, type = "hypo")

diffMethPerChr(myDiff, plot = T, qvalue.cutoff = 0.01, meth.cutoff = 25)

annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff25p, gene.obj)

promoters <- regionCounts(methRaw_CHG, gene.obj$promoters)
head(promoters[[1]])
introns <- regionCounts(methRaw_CHG, gene.obj$introns)
head(introns[[1]])
exons <- regionCounts(methRaw_CHG, gene.obj$exons)
head(exons[[1]])

diffAnn <- annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff25p, gene.obj)
head(getAssociationWithTSS(diffAnn))

getTargetAnnotationStats(diffAnn, percentage = TRUE, precedence = TRUE)

plotTargetAnnotation(diffAnn, precedence = TRUE, main = "Differential Methylation Annotation")

getFeatsWithTargetStats(diffAnn, percentage = TRUE)

The bismark.read function is returning the error message:
Error in .local(location, sample.id, assembly, save.folder, save.context,  :
  File supplied as the 'location' argument doesn't exist
can not find file at:

So, for some reason one of the file location/file name strings is empty. I'm not sure which one is empty since it didn't tell me. I understand my question is a little vague; however, any assistance will be very appreciated.

Sincerely,
Jeff Colfer

You have identified that the problem exists in the location of the files.

A smart solution to the issue pointed by you lies in understanding how to give file location. Try removing the "system.file" and the option "package".

You may further clarify your question for clear answer.
